subject: GCP listing orchestration + co-sell procurement: kickoff & action items
messages:
From: Priya Rao <priya@acmecloud.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmecloud.com>, GCP Marketplace Enablement <gcp-enable@google.com>
Date: 2027-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + GCP listing interest

Rafael — great to meet last week at CloudFest. AcmeCloud’s procurement and platform teams are keen to get Redwood listed on GCP Marketplace and understand the co-sell process.

Top asks from our side:
- Typical procurement checklist for public sector customers (SOC2/HSM specifics)
- How pricing appears on Marketplace and recommended SKU mapping
- Timeline for sandbox listing and production go-live

Attaching a short vendor intake template that our procurement team fills out. Can we book a 30-min working session next week with your marketplace/enablement owner?

Thanks,
Priya
Director, Cloud Partnerships — AcmeCloud
[Attachment: acme_vendor_intake_template.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + GCP listing interest

Priya — thanks, excited to run this with you. Quick answers up front and a proposed agenda:

1) Procurement checklist: we have a condensed GCP-ready checklist + full SOC2 evidence pack; will share.
2) Pricing/SKUs: we recommend a metered compute SKU + optional support SKU; we’ll map to your contract language.
3) Timeline: sandbox listing in ~3 weeks, production ~6-8 weeks depending on procurement review.

Proposed 30-min agenda for next Tue: intake review, required artifacts, procurement gate owners, and a mutual action plan. Inviting Lauren (marketplace ops) and Karthik (billing/finance).

Next steps: I’ll upload our checklist and a draft MSA with typical redlines for GCP listings.

Best,
Rafael
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: gcp_listing_checklist.xlsx (xlsx), draft_msa_redlined.pdf (pdf)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + GCP listing interest — working session materials

Hi all — attaching the checklist I mentioned and an onboarding runbook excerpt. Please review the checklist tabs: artifacts, security evidence, SKU mapping, and billing triggers.

Agenda draft for 2027-05-10 10:00am PT (30 min):
- 0-5 min: Introductions & goals (Priya/Rafael)
- 5-12 min: Procurement intake walk-through (AcmeCloud)
- 12-22 min: Marketplace operational items (sandbox vs prod, test images, billing IDs)
- 22-30 min: Mutual action plan & owners

Logistics: we’ll use the GCP enablement contact to validate required artifacts — looping them in.

Cheers,
Lauren
Marketplace Program Manager — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: onboarding_runbook_extract.pdf (pdf)]

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmecloud.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya@acmecloud.com>, GCP Marketplace Enablement <gcp-enable@google.com>
Date: 2027-05-06T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + GCP listing interest — procurement questions

Thanks all. A few procurement-specific clarifications before the session:
- Our legal wants confirmation: Redwood’s MSA accepts customer-specific data residency clauses? (we’re likely to require EU-only processing for some customers)
- Can Redwood provide a standard SOC2 report + an alternate evidence flow for customers on the Marketplace (i.e., where we link to your hosted evidence portal)?
- How are support SLAs surfaced in the Marketplace listing vs separate support contract?

I’ve attached our procurement intake filled where we’ve flagged the residency requirement. Please confirm which items are gating for our procurement review so we can triage.

Samir
Sr. Procurement Manager — AcmeCloud
[Attachment: acme_vendor_intake_completed.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmecloud.com>, Priya Rao <priya@acmecloud.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: GCP Marketplace Enablement <gcp-enable@google.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + GCP listing interest — procurement questions answered

Samir / Priya — brief answers from finance & legal to help the kickoff:

1) Data residency: Redwood supports region pinning for private deployments; for hosted listings we can surface region-specific SKUs and provide an EU-only model variant under Private or Dedicated options. We will note the EU-residency customers as a gating item for production listing.

2) SOC2 & evidence: we provide an up-to-date SOC2 report and a customer portal link for on-demand evidence. For Marketplace procurement, we can supply both the PDF report + a portal access token redaction flow.

3) Support SLAs: Marketplace listing shows baseline support tier and link to an external support contract. We recommend mapping a "Marketplace Basic" SKU visible on the product page and a separate "Premium Support" contract referenced on procurement docs.

Action items (owners & dates):
- Rafael: finalize mutual action plan and send to AcmeCloud by 2027-05-11.
- Lauren: prepare sandbox checklist and test account details by 2027-05-13.
- Karthik: provide sample SKU mapping and estimated billing flow to AcmeCloud by 2027-05-12.
- Priya/Samir: confirm procurement gate list and whether EU-only residency is required for their customers by 2027-05-12.

I’ll join the working session on 2027-05-10 to walk through the checklist.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Finance & Marketplace Billing — Redwood Inference
